newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Trading on Dhaka bourse to resume today.
newsitem.headline: Trading on Dhaka bourse to resume today.

text.p: Trading on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE), the country's main bourse, resumes after two days of suspension due to agitations by hundreds of small investors over a lingering bearishness and sharp fall in prices, brokers said.

"The market will resume today as the investors call off their programme after the government and business leaders agreed on providing necessary incentives to striking small investors. This may revive investors' confidence," said broker M. Ahmed.
"But I don't think there will be whole-hearted participation by them. Many will prefer to watch the market for couple of days before making fresh commitments," said another broker.

Trading on the DSE remained suspended on Sunday and Monday as hundreds of small investors in the kerb market staged demonstrations outside the DSE building prventing stock brokers from entering the floor.

The incentives include resumption of credit to investors by state-owned Investment Corporation of Bangladesh and formation of committees to oversee share prices movement and ensure transperency in transactions.
The DSE all-share price index closed 48.8 points or 1.83 percent down at 2,618.3 on Saturday. Friday is the weekend in Moslem Bangladesh. -- Dhaka Newsroom +880-2-506363.
